Giants head coach John Harbaugh said Dart's injured left knee is being evaluated in the aftermath of the starting quarterback exiting the game in defeat at the Los Angeles Rams on Monday night . Dart was hurt less than four minutes into the game while being pressured on third-and-eight. Rams linebacker Byron Young hit Dart from the quarterback's right side, sending him into linebacker Josaiah Stewart, who undercut Dart's legs, resulting in a heavy fall. But the Spaniard, who was appointed in 2019, has committed his future to the club and confirmation of his new agreement is expected during this international break. When asked about his contract situation ahead of Arsenal's trip to Brighton on Saturday, Arteta said: "I think we are all very much aligned; whenever the time is right, we'll get that done. messages.text: Dual Champion Hurdle winner Hurricane Fly dies aged 22

metadata.summary: Hurricane Fly, the Willie Mullins-trained dual Champion Hurdle winner, has died at the age of 22.
metadata.content: Hurricane Fly: Willie Mullins-trained dual Champion Hurdle winner dies aged 22 | Racing News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Hurricane Fly: Willie Mullins-trained dual Champion Hurdle winner dies aged 22 Willie Mullins' brilliant hurdler Hurricane Fly has passed away at the age of 22; the winner of 22 Grade 1's will be remembered as one of the all-time greats of the National Hunt sphere. Tuesday 22 September 2026 18:23, UK Image: Hurricane Fly ridden by Ruby Walsh jumps the last fence and goes on to win the Stan James Champion Hurdle Challenge Trophy Hurricane Fly, the Willie Mullins-trained dual Champion Hurdle winner, has died at the age of 22. The son of Montjeu proved himself one of the greats of recent National Hunt history, winning the Champion Hurdle at Cheltenham in 2011 and 2013 and the Irish Champion Hurdle five times on the spin between 2011 and 2015. In total Hurricane Fly won a record breaking 22 Grade One races. He was retired in 2015 after a nine-year career to spend his days alongside other equine greats such as Faugheen, Hardy Eustace and Beef Or Salmon at the Irish National Stud. Mullins described the superstar hurdler as "awesome" and "one of the biggest legends" to pass through his Closutton yard. Regular jockey Ruby Walsh simply labelled him "the perfect horse" and the best jumper of a hurdle he ever rode. metadata.summary: Great Britain's stay at the Billie Jean King Cup Finals lasted only one match as they fell to Czechia in the quarter-finals in Shenzhen.
metadata.content: Billie Jean King Cup: Great Britain knocked out at quarter-final stage vs Czech Republic as Katie Boulter, Sonay Kartal beaten | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Billie Jean King Cup: Great Britain knocked out at quarter-final stage vs Czech Republic as Katie Boulter, Sonay Kartal beaten Katie Boulter and Sonay Kartal suffer defeats to Linda Noskova and Marie Bouzkova of the Czech Republic respectively to exit Billie Jean King Cup at quarter-final stage; you can also watch the Laver Cup at The O2 in London from 25-27 September live on Sky Sports Tuesday 22 September 2026 17:10, UK Image: Katie Boulter (left) and Great Britain are out of the Billie Jean King Cup after defeat to the Czech Republic Great Britain's stay at the Billie Jean King Cup Finals lasted only one match as they fell to Czechia in the quarter-finals in Shenzhen. Anne Keothavong's side were bidding to reach the last four for the fourth time in five years but were considerable underdogs and defeats for Sonay Kartal and Katie Boulter sealed their fate. Led by Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova, the whole Czech team is ranked higher than any of Britain's players, and it was Noskova who sealed victory with a 6-2 7-6 (7-3) win over Boulter. That followed a lengthy struggle between Marie Bouzkova and Kartal lasting a minute short of three hours, which the Czech eventually took 7-6 (7-2) 4-6 6-4. What is tennis' Laver Cup?
